params.name: pagination.page
params.description: Page number for paginated results, starting from 1.

params.name: pagination.limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: pagination.as_of_time
params.description: RFC3339 timestamp to return results as they were at a specific point in time (time-travel query).

params.name: pagination.sort_order
params.description: Sort direction for paginated results. Accepted values are ASC and DESC.
